snippet.title: Barty's Adventure - Steam Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Barty's Adventure on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3205260/Bartys_Adventure/

Join our Discord Community: https://discord.gg/7eB9e7MK
Sign up for our Newsletter: https://stuffies-town-tribune-a-bartys-adventure-newsletter.ghost.io/
Follow us on Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/bartysadventure.bsky.social

A new baby is coming in three days! There’s so much to do, especially if Barty is to prevent the Colic from returning once again. Luckily, with the help of the Bubble Fairy, Barty has all the time he needs. Explore the House to recover the lost puppies who hold the key to stopping this calamity. Or choose to go in a completely different direction, discovering several alternate plans to save the day. 

At any point during the three-day cycle, you can choose to loop back in time to the morning of the first day. But before you restart, the Bubble Fairy will let you keep some things with you. Powerups, relationship statuses, quest progress... you have the freedom to choose exactly how to start the new cycle!
